note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received by Mr. S. J. Crail at the Lisburn Union offices on 26 April 1933. Five divisions were nominated; there were no nominations for the other eleven, whose sitting members were automatically returned. Polling in County Down took place on 25 May 1933. Filed on 1933-05-25, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Seven of the eleven sitting members returned without nomination are recorded from Lisburn Standard reports of the council's meetings (30 May - 14 November 1933); Glassdrummond fell vacant by the death of R. C. Martin and T. B. Morrow was co-opted (not an election); Ballyskeagh, Breda and Drumbo remain unnamed (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). division inferred from the 1930 return (James Ireland, Ougley, from the meetings pass); the Lisburn Standard report names the member as sitting within six months of 25 May 1933. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
